g.text: Apply shared saved-outcome rules (diagram index / FC-07).
Resolve accessible success before new-generation checks:
no generation or extra usage, even at 20 used or during outage.
Permissions, privacy, deletion/expiry and current catalog apply.
[Accessible saved success for the same logical request]
No course starts or roadmap activation on replay.
Preview and explicit acceptance still required for proposals.
Match goals and interests to approved catalog.
Adjust using experience, optional latest assessment,
and completed courses; do not attach account identity.
Only published content open to new learners.
Exclude completed courses from next-course suggestions.
Count a successful logical AI request once.
Failed requests do not consume allowance.
Suggestions do not start courses or replace a roadmap.
